subject: Renewal + Capacity Lift: proposed staged commit + burst flexibility
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@retailnova.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.inference <olga_petrov@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@retailnova.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RetailNova renewal – need higher committed monthly units + burst band

Olga,

Hope you're well. We're coming up on our September renewal and usage is now running ~3.5x the committed monthly tokens compared to Q2. The product team is planning a holiday push that will drive another step function in inference calls.

Two ask items to discuss:
- We want to increase our monthly committed token band from 100M -> 300M for the next 12 months.
- We also need a predictable burst cushion (temporary allowance up to +40% with controlled overage pricing) for seasonal spikes.

Can you share what a staged commit increase with step-up pricing would look like and whether Redwood can offer an early-renewal credit to smooth the cost in month 1? Also, any impacts to rate limits / soft-throttle windows we should expect?

Thanks — happy to jump on a call this week.

Samir Patel
CFO, RetailNova
samir@retailnova.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RetailNova renewal – need higher committed monthly units + burst band

Samir — thanks for the flag and congrats on the usage growth, that's great to see.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
1) I'll loop in Aditya (account lead) and Marissa (sales ops) to draft a staged-commit proposal with an optional burst pocket.
2) We will include a one-time early-renewal credit and show net first-quarter cash impact vs list.
3) Karthik (billing) will validate rate-limit impacts for the 300M commit + 40% burst scenario so we can call out any soft-throttle risks.

Can you confirm the target go-live for the new commit (you mentioned holiday push — is that Oct 15 or Nov 1)? Also, please attach any updated forecast or spike profiles so we can size the burst pocket appropriately.

I'll get a draft over by Thursday EOD PT. If you'd prefer a short sync, I'm available Thu 10–11 or Fri 09–11.

Cheers,

Olga Petrov

Redwood Inference

Hi Olga / Aditya —

Thanks. Confirming target go-live: Oct 15, 2027. Forecast attached — the core service sees a sustained 3–4x uplift during the holiday window and short 6–8x microbursts around major promotions. We are hoping the burst pocket covers typical promotion spikes without triggering hard overages.

Also note procurement will need a 12-month term and a clause to allow an additional mid-term top-up without an SLA reset (we can't tolerate a 72-hour provisioning hold during peak).

Elena Ruiz

elena@retailnova.com

From: aditya_rao@redwood.inference <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Patel <samir@retailnova.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@redwood.inference>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.inference, marissa_cole@redwood.inference, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: RetailNova renewal – proposed staged commit + burst flexibility

Samir / Elena —

Appreciate the replay and the forecast. Draft proposal attached (RetailNova_Renewal_Proposal_v1.pdf) with three options:

Option A — Aggressive commit (preferred price): 300M monthly commit, 12-month term, 20% early-renewal credit applied month 1. Burst allowance: +40% with overage at a blended discounted overage rate.
Option B — Staged ladder (risk-mitigation): Start 200M month 1–3, step to 300M month 4–12. 12-month term; prorated early-renewal credit vs Option A. Burst pocket: +30%.
Option C — Flexible top-up: 150M base commit + pre-purchased burst credits (blocks of 25M) with a lower commit price and self-service top-ups; useful if you want to avoid re-contracting.

Key notes:
- Rate limits: the API per-minute rate band for your account will increase proportionally to committed throughput, but we will keep soft-throttle thresholds for microbursts. For Options A/B we can guarantee that normal promotion spikes stay within the burst pocket without introducing hard 503s; extreme 6–8x microbursts may still see transient tail latency.
- Provisioning: we can commit to capacity in the same region; self-service top-up (Option C) can be near-immediate; staged increases will have a short provisioning handshake (<= 4 hours) if scheduled in advance — we will include a clause to avoid a 72-hour SLA during peak.

Next steps: please review Option A/B/C and tell us which you prefer; if Option A is chosen we can prepare final commercial redline and DocuSign.

Attachments: RetailNova_Renewal_Proposal_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@retailnova.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.inference, olga_petrov@redwood.inference
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@retailnova.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RetailNova renewal – proposed staged commit + burst flexibility

Aditya / Olga —

We reviewed the options with finance and ops. Prefer Option B (staged ladder) but with two adjustments:
1) Increase month-1 commit to 225M (gives runway for early traffic).
2) Burst allowance at 40% (not 30%) for months 1–4, then 25% thereafter.

If Redwood can accept those adjustments and include the 20% early-renewal credit scaled for the staged ladder, we can sign within 48 hours. Please advise on any material billing/technical constraints.

Samir
From: marissa_cole@redwood.inference <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Patel <samir@retailnova.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.inference, olga_petrov@redwood.inference
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RetailNova renewal – proposed staged commit + burst flexibility

Samir —

Thanks — we can accommodate Option B with your two adjustments. Summary changes we'll reflect in the final SOW:
- Month 1 commit: 225M; Months 2–3: 250M; Month 4 onward: 300M (12-month term).
- Burst pocket: 40% for months 1–4, 25% thereafter.
- Early-renewal credit: 20% applied to month 1 invoice, prorated across the staged ladder (we'll show the calculation in the redline).
- Provisioning SLA: <4 hours for scheduled top-ups; emergency on-call escalation for unplanned spikes.

I'll route the redline to legal/finance and send a DocuSign link today. Expect DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/execute?doc=RN-Renewal-2027

Attachments: final SOW will be attached to the DocuSign envelope.

Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference
